title: How close can we pin down the longest run of one sign? Introductory text to The longest sign run of Keiper-Li second differences: a torus problem and its dual
description: A plain-language introduction to a research paper on the longest run of one sign among the Keiper-Li second differences, as a torus problem and its dual. The paper has the proofs; this note has the idea, and it says what the paper does and does not claim.
